title: Editor Media And Utility Node Readiness
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Work path, owner repository set, Checklist target, or Evidence target before editing.
Media and utility add-node readiness cannot be derived from both Core placement facts and Backend advertised mutation operation kinds.
Unsupported image, page-break, spacer, divider, or toc insertion appears as a ready visible add action.
Unsupported media or utility insert contracts lack an exact Core/Backend blocked reason.
Utility paper preview blocks gain editing controls before a repository-owned mutation and authoring contract exists.
The slice enables Core or Backend media/utility insertion semantics before those repositories advertise owned operations.

The slice enables WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, direct image/page-break/spacer/divider/toc authoring, durable drafts, collaboration, production readiness, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
verificationTarget: Editor exposes bounded media and utility node readiness facts for image, page-break, spacer, divider, and toc using Core placement and Backend operation capability inputs, keeps unsupported contracts and visible add actions blocked, and marks utility paper surfaces without enabling mutation transport or WYSIWYG behavior.
summary: Done: Editor merge commit 80a46f03cc05a929ab0f67a8615236bf0908b8bc adds a bounded media and utility node readiness classifier. utilityNodeReadiness builds readiness facts for image, page-break, spacer, divider, and toc from Core placement allowed child types, Backend mutationOperations for the current active package/document pair, and the Editor add-node contract builder. image stays blocked when the Core runtime container cannot accept image children; page-break, spacer, divider, and toc stay blocked because the Editor contract does not expose Core/Backend insert operations for those node kinds and Backend does not advertise page-break.insert, spacer.insert, divider.insert, toc.insert, or image.insert. Visible add-node actions do not expose unsupported media or utility buttons, and PaperBlock marks utility preview surfaces with data-utility-node-kind/data-utility-node-readiness without adding textarea or contenteditable controls. This does not enable Core or Backend media/utility mutation transport, document v4 insert semantics, direct image/page-break/spacer/divider/toc editing, WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, durable drafts, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
